name: prepr
description: Prepr CMS skills for AI agents: connect to the Prepr MCP server, design and build your content model, review it, and manage content.

interface.longDescription: Design, build and review your Prepr CMS content model, and create and manage content, through the Prepr MCP server. Every change is shown as a plan that names the target environment and waits for your approval; deletes need a second confirmation. Requires a Prepr account; what the agent may do follows your Prepr role and the environment's MCP permissions.
defaultPrompt: Review our Prepr schema and tell me what to improve.
Help me model an Events section in Prepr.
